# External verified sources

This directory contains compatibility-pinned, kernel-checked Lean sources.

- `PNT*.lean` and `WienerCore.lean` are adapted from
  `PrimeNumberTheoremAnd` at tag `v4.27.0-rc1`.
- `Sieve*.lean` are compatibility adaptations of Mathlib's Selberg-sieve
  development at revision `32d24245c7a12ded17325299fd41d412022cd3fe`.

See the repository-root `NOTICE.md` and `LICENSE` for provenance and
licensing.
